Name: T3 Deck
Description: Watch and steer T3 Code threads from Stream Deck: thread status, stop, prompts, model options and answers, across every provider.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.activity.Name: Activity
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.activity.Tooltip: The most urgent thread matching a filter. Tap opens it in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.new.Name: New Thread
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.new.Tooltip: Starts a new thread in the selected thread's project, no project, or a chosen one; with a saved prompt or empty.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.send.Name: Send Prompt
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.send.Tooltip: Sends a saved prompt to the selected thread. Hold to interrupt and restart with it.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.steer.Name: Steer
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.steer.Tooltip: Adds a saved instruction to the selected thread's running turn.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.quick.Name: Quick Prompt
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.quick.Tooltip: Sends an everyday prompt to the selected thread: continue, fix tests, diagnose, explain, commit, or your own.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.stop.Name: Stop
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.stop.Tooltip: Stops the running turn of the thread selected in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.workflow.stop.Name: Stop Workflow
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.workflow.stop.Tooltip: Stops the workflows the thread runs (Claude). Hold to stop.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.model.Name: Model
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.model.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread to a favorite model, or to the next of T3 Code's favorites.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.effort.Name: Effort
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.effort.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's reasoning effort, or steps through what its model offers.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.speed.Name: Speed
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.speed.Tooltip: Toggles fast mode on the selected thread where its model offers it.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.permissions.Name: Permissions
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.permissions.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's access, from Supervised to Full access, or steps through them.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.plan.Name: Plan
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.plan.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread between Build and Plan.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.approve.Name: Approve
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.approve.Tooltip: Answers the selected thread's approval as far as its settings allow, or opens it in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.slot.Name: Thread
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.slot.Tooltip: One thread from the board, filled by key position: status, title and timer. Tap opens it in T3 Code; hold selects it.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.organize.Name: Organize
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.organize.Tooltip: Settles, pins, snoozes, archives or marks the selected thread unread.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.Name: Pull Request
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.Tooltip: The selected thread's pull request and its state. Tap opens it.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.branch.Name: Branch
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.branch.Tooltip: The selected thread's branch. Tap opens the thread in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.git.commit.Name: Commit
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.git.commit.Tooltip: Commits the selected thread's changes, or also pushes them or opens a PR, with T3 Code's commit message unless you set one.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.git.push.Name: Push
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.git.push.Tooltip: Pushes the selected thread's branch. Hold to push.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.git.pr.Name: Create PR
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.git.pr.Tooltip: Pushes the selected thread's branch and opens a pull request for it. Hold to create.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.git.pull.Name: Pull
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.git.pull.Tooltip: Pulls the selected thread's branch when it is behind its upstream.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.fix.Name: Fix Findings
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.fix.Tooltip: Sends T3 Code's Fix findings task for the selected thread's pull request: unresolved reviews and failing checks. Hold to send.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.explain.Name: Explain PR
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.explain.Tooltip: Asks the selected thread to walk through its pull request, as T3 Code's Explain does.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.ask.Name: Ask about PR
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.ask.Tooltip: Opens the thread that holds the pull request in T3 Code, to ask about it there.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.guide.Name: Review Guide
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.guide.Tooltip: Writes T3 Code's review guide for the selected thread's pull request, then opens the thread.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.editor.Name: Open in Editor
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.editor.Tooltip: Opens the selected thread's worktree or project in an editor, on the machine T3 Code runs on.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.health.Name: Health
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.health.Tooltip: The connection to T3 Code and its providers: the worst problem first (offline, needs pairing, signed out, update required, check failed). Tap reconnects.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.task.Name: Run Task
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.task.Tooltip: One of T3 Code's scheduled tasks: its name and when it runs next. Press runs it now.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.skill.Name: Run Skill
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.skill.Tooltip: Runs one of the thread's provider skills, the way picking it in T3 Code's composer and sending does.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.threads.Name: Threads Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.threads.Tooltip: Rotate through the threads that match its filter, selecting them in T3 Code; press or tap to open one.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.model.Name: Power Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.model.Tooltip: Changes the selected thread's model, effort or access; press or tap switches Speed where offered.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.prompts.Name: Prompts Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.prompts.Tooltip: Rotate through your prompts and templates. Press sends to the selected thread; hold starts a new thread.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.answer.Name: Answer Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.answer.Tooltip: Answers an agent's question choice by choice, and approvals as far as its settings allow.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.queue.Name: Queue Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.queue.Tooltip: Rotate through the selected thread's queued messages. Press sends one now (steering it in, or starting it while nothing runs); hold removes it.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.tasks.Name: Tasks Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.tasks.Tooltip: Rotate through T3 Code's scheduled tasks, with when each runs next. Press runs the shown task now; tap turns it off or back on.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.skills.Name: Skills Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.skills.Tooltip: Rotate through the thread's provider skills. Press or tap runs the shown one; touch and hold reads its description.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.pr.Name: PR Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.pr.Tooltip: Rotate through open pull requests. Press runs Fix findings, tap opens it in the browser, touch and hold reads its findings.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.limits.Name: Limits
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.limits.Tooltip: A provider's subscription limit, pooled like T3 Code's Limits: % left, next reset and banked resets. Tap refreshes; hold opens T3 Code's Usage or uses a reset.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.limits.Name: Limits Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.limits.Tooltip: Rotate through every provider's limit windows. Press or tap refreshes; hold the press to open T3 Code's Usage or use a reset.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.usage.Name: Usage
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.usage.Tooltip: A period's API-estimate cost, tokens and sessions, as T3 Code's Usage shows them, on one machine or all. Tap refreshes; hold also reloads model prices.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.usage.Name: Usage Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.usage.Tooltip: Rotate through a period's total and each model's cost, tokens, cache hit rate and cost per million tokens. Press or tap refreshes; a long press reloads model prices.

editor.label: Editor
editor.hint: Opens the selected thread's worktree, or its project's folder. T3 Code launches the editor on its own machine, which may not be this one.

pr.fixHint: Sends T3 Code's Fix findings task for the selected thread's pull request to that thread, queued if it is busy. Review comments and check output come from the host and are attached as untrusted data.
pr.dialHint: Lists open pull requests on the machine. Press runs Fix findings in the thread linked to it, or in a new worktree thread; tap opens it in the browser; touch and hold reads its findings.

git.messagePlaceholder: Written by T3 Code when empty
git.hint: Acts on the selected thread's worktree, or its project's folder. Pushing to the default branch always needs a hold; a PR from it is refused, as T3 Code would offer a new branch first.
git.pullHint: Pulls the selected thread's branch from its upstream when it is behind.

card.looking: Looking for T3 Code on this machine…
card.linkPlaceholder: Paste a pair link from Settings → Sharing & access
card.accessHelp: T3 Deck asks to read threads and act on them, within what the link allows. Revoke it in Settings → Sharing & access.
card.shared: Every machine you add is shared by all T3 Deck actions. Each action follows the machine picked above.
card.notRunning: T3 Code isn't running on this machine. Open it, or paste a pair link from another machine below.
card.howToPair: In T3 Code, open Settings → Sharing & access, create a pair link, and paste it below.
card.picked: This action shows and acts on threads from the machine you pick.
card.pasteFromMachine: Paste a pair link from this machine below.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.appLinkHint: Use t3code-dev to open threads in a development build.
advanced.stateLineLabel: Show the colored line under each strip
advanced.stateHint: Flow draws one picture across neighboring dials. Thread state tints a strip green when an unseen turn is done, red when failed and amber when it needs you. Each dial can override this in its own settings.
advanced.styleHint: List turns through a dial's items like a wheel, Carousel shows each as a tile between its neighbors. Per dial default uses List for the Threads dial, Classic for the others; Classic shows the Power dial as a slider. Long text moves once the dial rests, twice, then stops; touch and hold the strip to read it all, and turn to scroll.
advanced.maxEffortHint: Gradient colors every effort level along a ladder in the model's own color, turning toward violet at the top, and gives each model and Fast its provider's gradient. Solid and Model color mark only the top effort level, in violet or the model's color; Off leaves them plain. Ultrathink keeps T3 Code's spectrum.
advanced.motionHint: Full spins running threads, pulses threads waiting on you and flashes finishes and failures. Reduced spins slowly and doesn't pulse. Off keeps every face still.
advanced.confirmHint: Applies to Send Prompt, Steer, Quick Prompt and the Prompts dial; Model, Effort, Speed, Access and the Power dial always apply at once. Review shows what goes where on the first press; press again within 10 seconds to send. Hold sends on a held press, so holding can't also restart or start a thread. Each action can override this.

filter.attention: Needs you: approval, question, failure or unread result

slot.label: Slot
slot.hint: By key position fills Thread keys left to right, top to bottom. Threads are ordered: needs approval, has a question, running, then the rest. Tap opens, hold selects.

activity.hint: Shows the most urgent matching thread. More Activity keys with the same settings show the next ones, by key position.

answer.hint: Turn between this choice and Deny. A request that doesn't offer the choice opens in T3 Code instead. Touch and hold the strip to read a long request in full.

send.promptPlaceholder: Run the tests and fix what fails
send.hint: Goes to the thread selected in T3 Code: it starts a turn, or steers or queues behind a running one. Hold the key to interrupt and restart with it.

steer.promptPlaceholder: Keep the change small and skip the refactor
steer.hint: Adds to the selected thread's running turn. It's dimmed while the thread is idle.

quick.customPlaceholder: Type the prompt this key sends
quick.hint: Goes to the thread selected in T3 Code. Hold the key to interrupt and restart with it.

new.promptPlaceholder: Optional: Review the open pull request
new.title: Thread title
new.hint: With a prompt, the thread starts working and the deck selects it. Without one, it opens empty in T3 Code. With no thread selected, it starts with no project. It uses T3 Code's default model and access.

model.hint: Cycling steps through T3 Code's favorite models, across providers, or the thread's provider's models when you have none. Picking another provider's model hands the thread over, as T3 Code's model picker does.

effort.hint: Cycling steps through the efforts the selected thread's model offers. A set effort its model doesn't offer dims the key. Ultrathink doesn't change the effort: like T3 Code, it prefixes the prompts the deck sends to that thread until you pick another effort.

permissions.hint: Applies to the selected thread from its next step. Only the modes its provider supports are offered.

approve.hint: Answers the selected thread's approval. A request that doesn't offer this choice, or that the deck can't answer, opens in T3 Code. Deny is its own key.

prompts.label: Prompts
prompts.templatesLabel: Add Continue, Fix tests, Diagnose, Explain and Commit
prompts.hint: Rotate to choose, press to send to the selected thread, hold to start a new thread.

threads.hint: Rotate through the matching threads, most urgent first; the one the dial rests on becomes T3 Code's selection. Press or tap opens it.

power.hint: Rotate to preview, press to apply to the selected thread. Model turns through T3 Code's favorite models across providers. Press with nothing to apply, or tap, to switch Speed when the model offers it. Ultrathink, where Claude offers it, prefixes the deck's next prompts to the thread.

limits.hint: Pooled across the provider's accounts on the chosen machines, as T3 Code's Limits shows it. Tap refreshes. The tick on the bar is where even pace would be.
limits.spendHint: Holding spends one reset credit on the account T3 Code would refill first. It needs provider access: if the pairing lacks it, the machine's next pair link asks for it.

usage.hint: T3 Code's API estimate for the period, across the chosen machines; a folder two machines share counts once. Tap reads again, hold also reloads model prices. Needs usage access.
usage.dialHint: Rotate from the period's total through each model, by cost. Press or tap reads again; a long press also reloads model prices. Needs usage access.

target.label: Target
target.hint: The key acts on this thread even when another is selected, and shows a small pin. Archived or deleted, it shows as not available until you pick another.

queue.hint: Follows the selected thread's queue. Press sends the shown message now: into the running turn where the provider takes steering, or as the next turn when nothing runs, which also releases a queue Stop held. Hold removes it.

task.label: Task
task.hint: Press runs the task now, as T3 Code's Run now does; it keeps its schedule. Tasks come from T3 Code's Settings → Scheduled tasks.
task.dialHint: Rotate through the machine's scheduled tasks. Press runs the shown one now; tap turns it off, and tapping again turns it back on.

skill.label: Skill
skill.extraPlaceholder: Optional: what to tell it, after the skill
skill.hint: Sends the skill to the thread as T3 Code's composer does ($name, then your text). Skills come from the thread's provider for its checkout: Codex, Claude and Antigravity list them.
skill.dialHint: Rotate through the thread's provider skills for its checkout. Press or tap runs the shown one, touch and hold reads its description.

workflow.hint: Stops the workflows the thread runs, as T3 Code's Lineage panel does. Only Claude's workflows can be stopped. Hold the key to stop; a stopped workflow can't be resumed.

usage.updateDeck: Update T3 Deck to read usage
